notes: Arkansas minimum wage and overtime apply to employers with 4 or more employees (DOL table).
No state meal-period requirement for adults in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (Arkansas DOLL child-labor page; Ark. Code not fetched): state hour limits cover children under 17 only (none for 17-year-olds). Under-16 state limits are looser than federal 3 h/18 h; federal.json still applies. 16-year-olds may not work midnight-6 a.m. in retail/convenience stores under 4,500 sq ft or restaurants (except locked/drive-through-only), even before non-school days; encoded latest end midnight. Non-school-week rules assume every night precedes a non-school day. Extra param key max_days_week.
